findings.finding: Vector context (MSTATUS_VS) is enabled globally when misa('V') is detected. Zvdot4a8i depends on the V extension and uses the same vector register file, so no additional firmware enablement is needed.

Cold boot path calls mstatus_init() which enables MSTATUS_VS before S-mode entry. Zvdot4a8i requires no additional CSR configuration (no menvcfg bits, no mstateen bits, no new CSRs) beyond what the V extension already requires.

mstateen0 CSR configuration covers AIA, IMSIC, CTR, SRMCFG, CONTEXT, HSENVCFG, and SVSLCT bits. Zvdot4a8i does not require any mstateen bit — it is a pure unprivileged instruction extension with no privileged state gating.

The hart extension enumeration does not include Zvdot4a8i — correctly, since Zvdot4a8i is an unprivileged ISA extension (not a privileged extension) and does not require M-mode firmware to track or configure it separately from the base V extension.

menvcfg configuration covers CBZE, CBCFE, CBIE, PBMTE, STCE, CDE, ADUE bits for extensions that require supervisor-mode enablement. Zvdot4a8i does not require any menvcfg bit — vector instructions execute under MSTATUS_VS control which is already set.
